name: WhatsApp User
description: Admin-maintained mapping from a WhatsApp number to the ERPNext User whose permissions apply to queries sent from that number (playground.api.whatsapp.handle_message). Numbers not listed here, or disabled, can only use hello/ping.

fields.label: WhatsApp Number
fields.description: Any format (+91 98123 45678, 09812345678, ...). Saved normalised to country code + number, e.g. 919812345678.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Untick to stop this number reaching ERPNext data without deleting the mapping.

fields.label: ERPNext User
fields.description: Queries from this number run with this user's roles and User Permissions. The user must be enabled.
